newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs edge up on light volume.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs edge up on light volume.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts edged upward Tuesday on scant volume, following listless trade in the local market, traders said.
"The summer doldrums are here," a trader said.
A political row in India's ruling coalition, which caused a sell-off in GDRs Monday, was having little effect on trading, they said.
The regional Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party quit the minority coalition government late Monday.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.70 points higher at 84.91, an 0.83 percent rise, with the premium over the local market at 18.50 percent from 17.63 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index shed 4.92 points to 4,220.10.
Bajaj Auto lost $1.25 to $31.25/$33.75 and Reliance gained 20 cents to $21.60/$22.10.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index lost 1.58 points firmer, falling to 75.85 points, a premium of 43.22 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 2.18 points lower at 136.88, representing a discount to the local market of 1.57 percent.
